literal_source_claim: Banach spaces need not have a basis.
canonical_claim: There exists a Banach space over the real or complex scalars which has no Schauder basis.
domain_and_universes: An existentially bundled complete normed vector space; scalar choice (real, complex, or both) and universe level remain to be fixed from the primary statement and Lean object model.
quantifiers: an existential Banach space X with its additive, normed, scalar, and completeness structures
conclusion: There is no term of SchauderBasis K X for the selected scalar field K.

alternate_encodings.target: a separable reflexive Banach space without the approximation property
alternate_encodings.relationship: stronger primary-source construction implying the no-Schauder-basis root
alternate_encodings.checked_witness: none; source and Lean bridges remain open

alternate_encodings.target: for a fixed X, Not (Nonempty (SchauderBasis K X))
alternate_encodings.relationship: candidate inner predicate only, not the existential theorem

excluded_degenerate_cases: Hamel bases, nonseparable spaces used for a trivial cardinality obstruction, merely uncountable Schauder index sets, absence of an unconditional basis only, and a bare failure of a chosen sequence to be a basis may not replace Enflo's counterexample.
